name: badger-agent-control
description: An iPhone screen time and app blocker your agent can control through chat.

interface.longDescription:
Badger helps you manage screen time on your iPhone. Ask your chat to block distracting apps while you focus and unblock them when you’re done.

Connect your existing Badger account and choose the app groups your agent may control. Each request includes a reason. Badger records it and acknowledges it in your Badger chat. Success means Badger received the request; it does not confirm that your iPhone applied it. Create app groups and manage app selections in Badger. Pause or disconnect access anytime at gobadger.app/connect. An existing Badger account is required; download Badger: Your Willpower Agent on the App Store at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/badger-your-willpower-agent/id6817999408.
defaultPrompt: Block Distracting Apps while I work, because I need to focus.
Unblock Distracting Apps because my focus session is finished.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: phone account linking, exact app-group consent, conversational block/unblock requests with reasons, durable acceptance receipts, and connection pause/disconnect.

positive.expected_behavior: Show only consented group names and opaque IDs in chat. Do not reveal apps, usage, or phone state.

positive.prompt: Block Review distractions because I am working on the budget review.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact authorized group, send the stated reason with a fresh idempotency key, and report that Badger accepted the request. Do not claim iPhone enforcement.

positive.prompt: Unblock Review distractions because the budget review is finished.
positive.expected_behavior: Send the stated unblock reason and report durable acceptance. The request is recorded in the dedicated review account.

positive.prompt: Block Work apps because I am on a lunch break and want to switch off from work.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Work apps, use the stated lunch-break reason, and send a block request for only that group. Report that Badger accepted it. Leave Review distractions unchanged.

positive.prompt: Show my Badger app groups. Block Review distractions because I am writing. Then, when I say the writing is finished, unblock it.
positive.tools_triggered: list_app_groups, block_app_group; unblock_app_group only after the later user instruction
positive.expected_behavior: Maintain the named group for the later terse follow-up; use Writing finished as the reason. Do not invent a timer or future automatic action.

negative.expected_behavior: Without a previously established group, list authorized groups and ask which one. Do not send a block request.

negative.prompt: Unblock a group that I did not give you access to.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guess or invent a group ID, expand access, or send a control request. Explain how to reconnect with the desired group.

negative.prompt: Which apps are blocked on my iPhone and how long did I use each one today?
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection cannot read app membership, usage, or phone enforcement state. Do not fabricate those values.
